articles.source_excerpt: The official transaction log lists August 8 signings for Wayne Selden Jr. and Tony Wroten, a September 23 signing for Chris Crawford, and an October 9 signing for Vince Hunter.

events.label: Memphis signs Wayne Selden Jr.
events.raw_note: The official Memphis transaction log states that on August 8 the Grizzlies signed free agents Wayne Selden Jr., D.J. Stephens, Troy Williams and Tony Wroten.

events.label: Memphis signs Tony Wroten
events.raw_note: The official Memphis transaction log states that on August 8 the Grizzlies signed free agents Wayne Selden Jr., D.J. Stephens, Troy Williams and Tony Wroten.

events.label: Memphis signs Chris Crawford
events.raw_note: The official Memphis transaction log and training camp roster release state that on September 23 the Grizzlies signed guard Chris Crawford.

events.label: Memphis signs Vince Hunter
events.raw_note: The official Memphis transaction log states that on October 9 the Grizzlies signed free agent Vince Hunter.

articles.source_title: Memphis Grizzlies acquire draft rights to Ivan Rabb and Dillon Brooks
articles.source_excerpt: Official release announcing Memphis acquired the draft rights to Ivan Rabb and Dillon Brooks on draft night.

events.label: Memphis acquires the draft rights to Dillon Brooks and Ivan Rabb
events.raw_note: Memphis announced it acquired the draft rights to Ivan Rabb from Orlando and Dillon Brooks from Houston on June 22, 2017.

articles.source_title: Memphis Grizzlies finalize 2018-19 regular season roster
articles.source_excerpt: The official roster-finalization release states Markel Crawford signed on August 15, Brandon Goodwin on September 4, and Doral Moore on August 30.

events.label: Memphis signs Markel Crawford
events.raw_note: The official roster-finalization release says Crawford competed in preseason games after he was signed by Memphis on August 15.

events.label: Memphis signs Doral Moore
events.raw_note: The official roster-finalization release says Moore saw action in preseason games after he was signed by Memphis on August 30.

events.label: Memphis signs Brandon Goodwin
events.raw_note: The official roster-finalization release says Goodwin appeared in preseason games after signing with the Grizzlies on September 4.
